description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationService class within the OrangeHRM application, providing methods to access and set an EmployeeEducationDao object, which handles data access for employee education records.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationService
classes.description: Service class managing employee education data access, lazy-initializing the EmployeeEducationDao when needed.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeEducationDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeEducationDao instance, allowing dependency injection.
